title: R-GUARD: An effective DLR variation for NOGI BJJ
whyUseful: Explains the R-Guard shape as a no-gi De La Riva variation and why the reversed configuration behaves differently once there is no cloth to hold.

title: R-Guard | Sweeps | Wrestle Up Attacks | Reverse Guard
whyUseful: Shows the offensive branches of the position: the sweeps and the wrestle-up attacks the guard player chains once the leg is free.
